Why Choose Jack
Local. Trusted.
Zero Stress.

Over a decade serving surfers and travellers in Kuta Lombok. Here's what sets us apart.

🚚

Free Delivery & Pick-Up

We bring the scooter to you anywhere in Kuta. No need to waste your first morning finding us — we come to you.

⛑️

2 Helmets Included

SNI-standard helmets included upon request. Your safety matters — ride properly protected.

🏄

Surf Rack Available

Surf rack included in the price. Get your board to Gerupuk, Selong Belanak, or Mawi without the hassle.

✨

Clean & Well-Maintained

Every bike arrives clean and fully checked. We care about the condition of our fleet — because you're riding it.

💬

24/7 WhatsApp Support

Got a question at 11pm? Message us. We're local and always reachable. No middlemen, no call centres.

🗺️

Real Local Knowledge

Born and raised in Kuta Lombok. Ask me about the best surf spots, hidden roads, restaurants — I know this island.

📅

Flexible Rental Periods

Daily, weekly, or monthly — whatever works for your trip. Better rates the longer you stay.

🛵

Scooter Riding Lessons

Never ridden a scooter? No problem. Jack offers basic riding lessons so you can explore safely and confidently.

🚗

Private Taxi Services

Need a lift to the airport, Senggigi, or a day trip further afield? We offer private taxi services too.

About Jack
Born Here.
Know Every Road.

I'm Jack Arland, a local from Kuta Lombok. I've been in the scooter rental business for over 10 years — helping surfers, backpackers, and travellers explore this island safely and freely.

When you rent from me, you're not just getting a bike — you're getting a local friend who knows every road, every surf break, and every hidden gem on this island. Ask me anything.

I started this business to support my family here in Kuta Lombok, and to give travellers a genuinely great local experience. I love meeting new people and making sure your time here is unforgettable.

I speak Indonesian and English, and I'm always available on WhatsApp — day or night. Come find me near Biru Inn & Café in the heart of Kuta, or just message me and I'll come to you.
